exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   1  B will        11  B because
   2  A 'm going    12  A leave
   3  C shouldn't   13  B Must
   4  A It          14  A There
   5  A can         15  B could
   6  C keep        16  A Can
   7  B shouldn't   17  A mustn't
   8  B buy         18  C to
   9  A mustn't     19  B am seeing
  10  C will be     20  B Why


MAVZULAR BO'YIChA GURUHLASh:

  KELAJAK ZAMON (Unit 13) —
     1, 2, 8, 10, 12, 19
  'IT/THERE will be' (Unit 13) — 4, 10, 14
  MODAL FE'LLAR (Unit 14) —
     3, 5, 6, 7, 9, 13, 15, 16, 17
  BOG'LOVChI VA MAQSAD — 11, 18
  TAKLIF ShAKLI — 20


⚠⚠ 'IT WILL BE' ↔ 'THERE WILL BE' —
UCh MARTA TEKShIRILGAN:

   4  'IT will be WINDY in Miami.'
      'windy' — SIFAT → IT

  10  'THERE will be SNOW in Toronto.'
      'snow' — OT → THERE

  14  'THERE will be RAIN tomorrow.'
      'rain' — OT → THERE

  ⚠ QOIDA:
     SIFAT bilan  → IT will be
        (sunny, rainy, windy, snowy, foggy)
     OT bilan     → THERE will be
        (sun, rain, wind, snow, fog)

  ⚠ Workbook'ning 7-nazorat testida ham
  AYNAN shu qoida uch marta tekshirilgan
  edi. Ikkala kitob ham buni ENG MUHIM
  deb hisoblaydi.


──── KELAJAK ZAMONNING UCh ShAKLI ────

  1) WILL — o'sha zahotgi qaror, bashorat

     1  'I'm hungry. I WILL make myself a
         sandwich.'
        ⚠ Hozir qaror qildi → WILL.
     8  'She WILL BUY a new car.'
    12  'I'LL LEAVE the keys on the table.'

     ⚠ 'will' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl:
        'will BUY'   ✓
        'will BUYS'  ✗
        'will BOUGHT' ✗

  2) BE GOING TO — niyat, reja

     2  'I'M GOING TO buy a new house next
         year.'
        ⚠ Oldindan o'ylangan NIYAT.
    18  'He'S GOING TO save money TO buy a
         bicycle.'

  3) PRESENT CONTINUOUS —
     rejalashtirilgan, kelishilgan

    19  'I AM SEEING Steve TONIGHT.'
        ⚠ Uchrashuv KELIShILGAN.
        'I see Steve tonight' — XATO;
        'I saw' — o'tmish.


⚠ 1 va 2-BANDLAR FARQI — MUHIM:

   1  'I'm hungry. I WILL make a sandwich.'
      → Hozir qorni ochdi, ShU ZAHOTI
        qaror qildi → WILL

   2  'I'M GOING TO buy a house next year.'
      → Oldindan o'ylangan REJA →
        BE GOING TO

  Bu — Unit 13 ning asosiy farqi!


──── MODAL FE'LLAR (Unit 14) ────

  MUST / MUSTN'T — majburiyat / TAQIQ

     6  'You MUST KEEP your room clean.'
        (majburiyat)
     9  'You MUSTN'T leave your dog alone
         all day.'
        (TAQIQ — hayvonga zarar)
    13  'MUST I go to bed so early?'
        (Majburmanmi?)
    17  'You MUSTN'T smoke in hospitals.'
        (TAQIQ — qonun)

  SHOULD / SHOULDN'T — MASLAHAT

     3  'Lynn SHOULDN'T eat so much
         chocolate.'
        (maslahat — sog'liq uchun)
     7  'You SHOULDN'T speak loudly in a
         library.'
        (odob qoidasi)

  CAN — qobiliyat, ruxsat, iltimos

     5  'She CAN speak Japanese.'
        (qobiliyat)
    16  'CAN we have some cake, please?'
        (iltimos)

  COULD — 'can' ning O'TMIShI

    15  'Steven COULD ride a bicycle when he
         WAS five.'
        ⚠ KALIT: 'when he WAS five' —
        o'tmish.


⚠ 'MUSTN'T' ↔ 'SHOULDN'T' FARQI:

  MUSTN'T — QAT'IY TAQIQ (qonun, xavf)
     'You MUSTN'T smoke in hospitals.'
     'You MUSTN'T leave your dog alone.'

  SHOULDN'T — MASLAHAT (yaxshi emas)
     'You SHOULDN'T eat so much chocolate.'
     'You SHOULDN'T speak loudly.'

  ⚠ Testda 3, 7 (shouldn't) va
  9, 17 (mustn't) — kitob ataylab
  yonma-yon qo'ygan.


⚠ MODAL FE'LLARDAN KEYIN ASOSIY ShAKL:

   6  'must KEEP'  ✓  'must KEEPS' ✗
   8  'will BUY'   ✓  'will BUYS'  ✗
  12  'I'll LEAVE' ✓  'I'll LEAVES' ✗

  ⚠ 3-shaxsda ham '-s' QO'ShILMAYDI.


──── BOG'LOVChI VA MAQSAD ────

  11  'He joined a gym BECAUSE he wanted to
      lose weight.'
      SABAB → BECAUSE.

  18  'He's going to save money TO buy a
      new bicycle.'
      ⚠ MAQSAD → 'TO + fe'l' ('... uchun').
      'because' bo'lsa 'because he wants
      to buy' bo'lardi.

  20  'WHY don't you stop eating sweets?'
      ⚠ 'Why don't you ...?' — MASLAHAT/
      TAKLIF shakli (turg'un qolip).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a sandwich  = sendvich
  to join a gym = sport zaliga yozilmoq
  to lose weight = vazn tashlamoq
  a library   = kutubxona
  alone       = yolg'iz
  windy       = shamolli
  to save money = pul yig'moq
  sweets      = shirinliklar
  keys        = kalitlar

tasks.prompt: 1  I'm hungry. I ................. make myself a sandwich.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ KALIT: 'I'm hungry' — HOZIR qorni ochdi,
SHU ZAHOTI qaror qildi → WILL.

⚠ 2-band bilan solishtiring: u yerda
OLDINDAN o'ylangan reja → 'be going to'.

Bu — Unit 13 ning asosiy farqi!

tasks.prompt: 2  I ................. to buy a new house next year.
tasks.promptUz: Kelasi yil yangi uy sotib olmoqchiman.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ KALIT: 'TO buy' allaqachon bosilgan
→ 'be going TO'.

'next year' — oldindan o'ylangan NIYAT.

'will' bo'lsa 'will buy' bo'lardi ('to' siz).

tasks.prompt: 3  Lynn ................. eat so much chocolate.
tasks.promptUz: Linn bunchalik ko'p shokolad yemasligi kerak.
tasks.whyUz:
MASLAHAT (sog'liq uchun yomon) → SHOULDN'T.

⚠ 'must' — majburiyat, mantiqsiz.
⚠ 'should' — 'yeyishi kerak' degan ijobiy
ma'no berardi.

'so much chocolate' — sanalmaydigan.

tasks.prompt: 4  ................. will be windy in Miami on Tuesday.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ 'WINDY' — SIFAT → 'IT will be'.

⚠ 10 va 14-bandlar bilan solishtiring:
u yerda OT ('snow', 'rain') → 'THERE will be'.

'It's will be' — ikki fe'l, XATO.

tasks.prompt: 5  Lucy lives in Tokyo. She ................. speak Japanese.
tasks.promptUz: Lyusi Tokioda yashaydi. U yaponcha gapira oladi.
tasks.whyUz:
QOBILIYAT → CAN.

KALIT: Tokioda yashaydi → tilni biladi.

'mustn't' — taqiq, mantiqsiz;
'will' — kelajak, mantiqsiz.

tasks.prompt: 6  You must ................. your room clean.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ MODAL FE'LDAN keyin ASOSIY shakl:
  'must KEEP'    ✓
  'must KEEPS'   ✗
  'must KEEPING' ✗

'keep something clean' = toza tutmoq
(Coursebook 101-bet).

tasks.prompt: 7  You ................. speak loudly in a library.
tasks.whyUz:
ODOB QOIDASI → SHOULDN'T (maslahat).

⚠ 9 va 17-bandlar bilan solishtiring: u yerda
QAT'IY TAQIQ → 'mustn't'.

Kutubxonada baland gapirish — qonunbuzarlik
emas, odobsizlik.

tasks.prompt: 8  She will ................. a new car.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ 'WILL' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl:
  'will BUY'     ✓
  'will BUYS'    ✗
  'will BOUGHT'  ✗

3-shaxsda ham '-s' QO'SHILMAYDI.

tasks.prompt: 9  You ................. leave your dog alone in the house all day.
tasks.promptUz: Itingizni butun kun uyda yolg'iz qoldirmang.
tasks.whyUz:
QAT'IY TAQIQ (hayvonga zarar) → MUSTN'T.

⚠ 3 va 7-bandlar bilan solishtiring:
u yerda MASLAHAT → 'shouldn't'.

'couldn't' — o'tmish;
'had' — modal fe'l emas.

tasks.prompt: 10  There ................. snow in Toronto tomorrow.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ IKKI KALIT:
a) 'THERE' bosilgan → keyin OT ('snow');
b) 'TOMORROW' → KELAJAK → 'will be'.

'are' / 'is' — hozirgi zamon, 'tomorrow' ga
zid.

4-band bilan solishtiring: 'IT will be WINDY'.

tasks.prompt: 11  He joined a gym ................. he wanted to lose weight.
tasks.promptUz: U sport zaliga yozildi, chunki vazn tashlamoqchi edi.
tasks.whyUz:
SABAB → BECAUSE.

[natija] BECAUSE [sabab]:
vazn tashlash istagi — SABAB,
zalga yozilish — NATIJA.

⚠ 'so' bo'lsa tartib teskari bo'lardi.

tasks.prompt: 12  I'll ................. the keys on the table.
tasks.whyUz:
'I'LL' = I WILL → keyin ASOSIY shakl.

  'I'll LEAVE'    ✓
  'I'll LEAVES'   ✗
  'I'll LEAVING'  ✗

'leave' bu yerda = QOLDIRMOQ (ketmoq emas).

tasks.prompt: 13  ................. I go to bed so early?
tasks.whyUz:
'MUST I ...?' = Majburmanmi?

KALIT: 'so early' — norozilik ohangi, ya'ni
MAJBURIYAT haqida so'rayapti.

⚠ 'Can I ...?' — ruxsat so'rash (16-band).
⚠ 'Mustn't I ...?' — g'alati savol.

tasks.prompt: 14  ................. will be rain tomorrow.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ 'RAIN' — OT → 'THERE will be'.

⚠ 4-band bilan solishtiring:
  'IT will be RAINY' (sifat)
  'THERE will be RAIN' (ot)

10-band bilan bir xil qoida ('snow' — ot).

tasks.prompt: 15  Steven ................. ride a bicycle when he was five years old.
tasks.promptUz: Stiven besh yoshida velosiped mina olardi.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ KALIT: 'when he WAS five' — O'TMISH.

'could' — 'can' ning o'tmish shakli
(qobiliyat).

'must' / 'should' — hozirgi zamon modal
fe'llari, o'tmishga mos kelmaydi.

tasks.prompt: 16  ................. we have some cake, please?
tasks.whyUz:
ILTIMOS → CAN.

KALIT: 'PLEASE' iltimosni ko'rsatadi.

⚠ ILTIMOSDA savol bo'lsa ham 'SOME'
('any' emas).
⚠ 'Must we ...?' = majburmizmi? (13-band).

tasks.prompt: 17  You ................. smoke in hospitals.
tasks.whyUz:
QAT'IY TAQIQ (qonun) → MUSTN'T.

⚠ Coursebook 114-bet, 6-mashqning 6-bandi
AYNAN shu xato edi: 'You MUST smoke in
hospitals' → 'MUSTN'T'.

⚠ Workbook 7-nazorat testida ham bor edi.

tasks.prompt: 18  He's going to save money ................. buy a new bicycle.
tasks.promptUz: U yangi velosiped sotib olish uchun pul yig'moqchi.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ MAQSAD → 'TO + fe'l' ('... uchun').

'save money TO BUY a bicycle' = velosiped
sotib olish UCHUN pul yig'moq.

⚠ 'because' bo'lsa 'because he WANTS TO buy'
bo'lardi (ega va fe'l kerak).

⚠ KELISHILGAN uchrashuv → PRESENT
CONTINUOUS (kelajak ma'nosida).

'TONIGHT' — rejalashtirilgan vaqt.

'saw' — o'tmish;
'see' — doimiy odat ('I see him every day').

tasks.prompt: 20  ................. don't you stop eating sweets?
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ 'WHY don't you ...?' — MASLAHAT/TAKLIF
shakli (TURG'UN QOLIP).

'How don't you' / 'When don't you' — mavjud
emas.

'stop + V-ing' = ... ni to'xtatmoq.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with the missing words.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'sh joylarni tushib qolgan so'zlar bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   1  Be careful
   2  I'll get
   3  mustn't
   4  is going
   5  have
   6  There will be
   7  are you doing
   8  good idea to
   9  It will be
  10  so
  11  Would you like
  12  I can't
  13  have
  14  you going for
  15  are going
  16  too much
  17  play
  18  light
  19  make
  20  Don't

⚠ 1, 2, 6, 9, 11, 12, 20-bandlar GAP
BOShIDA turadi → BOSh HARF bilan.


──── KELAJAK ZAMON (Unit 13) ────

  Testda UCh xil kelajak shakli bor:

  1) WILL — bashorat, o'sha zahotgi qaror

     2  'I'LL GET an aspirin.'
        (o'sha zahoti qabul qilingan qaror)
     5  'I'm hot. I'LL HAVE a cold shower.'
     6  'THERE WILL BE fog in Paris
         tomorrow.'
     9  'IT WILL BE sunny in Milan
         tomorrow.'
    13  'You'll HAVE a lot of fun this week.'

  2) BE GOING TO — DALILGA asoslangan
     bashorat / niyat

     4  'There is a hole in the road. He IS
         GOING to fall.'
        ⚠ DALIL bor (yo'lda chuqur) →
        going to
    10  'She is hungry, SO she IS GOING TO
        make some sandwiches.'

  3) PRESENT CONTINUOUS —
     REJALAShTIRILGAN kelajak

     7  'What ARE YOU DOING this Sunday? —
         I'm going to the beach.'
    14  'Where ARE YOU GOING FOR your
         holidays this summer?'
    15  'What are you doing tonight? — We
         ARE GOING to the cinema.'


⚠ 6 va 9-BANDLAR — 'THERE WILL BE' yoki
'IT WILL BE'?

   6  'THERE WILL BE FOG in Paris.'
      'fog' — OT → THERE

   9  'IT WILL BE SUNNY in Milan.'
      'sunny' — SIFAT → IT

  ⚠ QOIDA:
     OT bilan   → 'There will be RAIN/FOG/
                  SNOW.'
     SIFAT bilan → 'It will be RAINY/FOGGY/
                  SNOWY.'

  (Coursebook 114-bet, 6-mashqning 4-bandi
   AYNAN shu xato edi: 'THERE will be snowy'
   → 'IT will be snowy'.)


──── MODAL FE'LLAR (Unit 14) ────

 3  'You MUSTN'T smoke in here. It's
     FORBIDDEN.'
    ⚠ KALIT: 'forbidden' (taqiqlangan)
    → MUSTN'T.

16  'You shouldn't eat TOO MUCH sugar.'
17  'You can't PLAY loud music in here.'
19  'You should always MAKE your bed in the
     morning.'
20  'DON'T write on the desk.'


──── TAKLIF VA JAVOB ────

11  'WOULD YOU LIKE to come windsurfing with
     me? — I'd love to.'
12  'How about going to the cinema? — I'd
     love to, BUT I CAN'T.'

  ⚠ TAKLIFNI RAD ETISh: 'I'd love to, but
  I can't.' — muloyim shakl.


──── LUG'AT ────

 1  'BE CAREFUL! You'll break the vase.'
    'be' fe'lining BUYRUQ shakli.

 8  'I don't think it's a GOOD IDEA TO eat
     too many sweets.'
    'it's a good idea TO + fe'l'

18  'It's illegal to LIGHT fires in
     forests.'
    ⚠ 'LIGHT a fire' = olov YOQMOQ
    ('burn' emas!).
    Coursebook 114-bet, 1-mashqning 9-bandi
    ham shu.

19  'MAKE your bed' = ko'rpa-to'shakni
    yig'ishtirmoq.
    ⚠ 'DO your bed' — XATO!


⚠ 16-BAND — 'TOO MUCH' va 'TOO MANY':

  TOO MUCH + SANALMAYDIGAN
     'too much sugar/money/water'

  TOO MANY + KO'PLIK
     'too many sweets/people/books'

  8-bandda: 'too many SWEETS' (ko'plik)
  16-bandda: 'too much SUGAR'
     (sanalmaydigan)

  Kitob ikkalasini ataylab bir betga
  qo'ygan!


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a vase      = vaza
  a headache  = bosh og'rig'i
  an aspirin  = aspirin
  forbidden   = taqiqlangan
  a hole      = chuqur, teshik
  fog         = tuman
  sweets      = shirinliklar
  windsurfing = vindserfing
  fun         = zavq, xursandchilik
  loud        = baland ovozli
  illegal     = noqonuniy
  to make the bed = ko'rpa-to'shakni
                yig'ishtirmoq
  a desk      = parta, yozuv stoli

tasks.whyUz:
OGOHLANTIRISH → 'BE CAREFUL!'

⚠ 'be' fe'lining BUYRUQ shakli:
  'BE careful!'  ✓
  'Are careful!' ✗

2-nazorat testining 3-mashqida ham bor edi.

tasks.prompt: 2  'I've got a headache.'  '..................... an aspirin.'
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ O'SHA ZAHOTGI QAROR/TAKLIF → 'I'LL GET'
(Unit 13 grammatikasi).

'TAKE an aspirin' (maslahat) ham to'g'ri.

Coursebook 114-bet, 2-mashq: 'I've got a
terrible headache. I'LL TAKE an aspirin.'
tasks.speak: 2  'I've got a headache.'  '..................... an aspirin.'

tasks.prompt: 3  You ......................... smoke in here. It's forbidden.
tasks.promptUz: Bu yerda chekish mumkin emas. Taqiqlangan.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ KALIT: 'It's FORBIDDEN' (taqiqlangan)
→ MUSTN'T (qat'iy taqiq).

'shouldn't' — maslahat, kuchsizroq.
'can't' — ruxsat yo'q, lekin 'forbidden'
bilan 'mustn't' aniqroq.
tasks.speak: 3  You ......................... smoke in here. It's forbidden.

tasks.prompt: 4  There is a hole in the road. He ................... to fall.
tasks.promptUz: Yo'lda chuqur bor. U yiqilib tushadi.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ DALIL BOR (yo'lda chuqur) → 'BE GOING TO'.

  WILL — dalilsiz bashorat
  BE GOING TO — DALILGA asoslangan bashorat

'to fall' allaqachon bosilgan, demak 'is
going' kerak.
tasks.speak: 4  There is a hole in the road. He ................... to fall.

tasks.promptUz: Issiq bo'lyapti. Sovuq dush qabul qilaman.
tasks.whyUz:
O'SHA ZAHOTGI QAROR → WILL ('I'll' bosilgan).

Keyin ASOSIY shakl: 'I'll HAVE'.

⚠ 'HAVE a shower' (Britaniya) /
'TAKE a shower' (Amerika).

⚠ 'FOG' — OT → 'THERE will be'.

  OT bilan: 'There will be FOG/RAIN/SNOW.'
  SIFAT bilan: 'It will be FOGGY/RAINY.'

9-band bilan solishtiring: 'sunny' — SIFAT
→ 'IT will be'.

tasks.prompt: 7  'What ..................................... this Sunday?'  'I'm going to the beach.'
tasks.whyUz:
KALIT: javob 'I'M GOING to the beach' —
Present Continuous (rejalashtirilgan kelajak).

Savol ham shu zamonda: 'What ARE YOU DOING?'

15-band bilan bir xil qurilma.
tasks.speak: 7  'What ..................................... this Sunday?'  'I'm going to the beach.'

tasks.prompt: 8  I don't think it's a ..................................... eat too many sweets.
tasks.promptUz: Juda ko'p shirinlik yeyish yaxshi fikr emas deb o'ylayman.
tasks.whyUz:
'it's a GOOD IDEA TO + fe'l' — turg'un
qurilma.

⚠ 'too MANY sweets' — 'sweets' KO'PLIK.
16-band bilan solishtiring: 'too MUCH sugar'
(sanalmaydigan).
tasks.speak: 8  I don't think it's a ..................................... eat too many sweets.

tasks.whyUz:
⚠ 'SUNNY' — SIFAT → 'IT will be'.

6-band bilan solishtiring: 'fog' — OT
→ 'THERE will be'.

Coursebook 114-bet, 6-mashqning 4-bandi AYNAN
shu xato edi: 'THERE will be snowy' ✗.

tasks.prompt: 10  She is hungry, ..................... she is going to make some sandwiches.
tasks.promptUz: U och, shuning uchun sendvich tayyorlamoqchi.
tasks.whyUz:
[sabab] SO [natija] → SO.

Och bo'lish — SABAB;
sendvich tayyorlash — NATIJA.

'because' bo'lsa tartib teskari bo'lardi.
tasks.speak: 10  She is hungry, ..................... she is going to make some sandwiches.

tasks.prompt: 11  '..................................... to come windsurfing with me?'  'I'd love to.'
tasks.whyUz:
TAKLIF → 'WOULD YOU LIKE TO ...?'

KALIT: javob 'I'D LOVE TO' — taklifga javob.

'to come' allaqachon bosilgan, demak 'Would
you like' kerak.
tasks.speak: 11  '..................................... to come windsurfing with me?'  'I'd love to.'

tasks.prompt: 12  'How about going to the cinema?'  'I'd love to, but ..................... .'
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ TAKLIFNI MULOYIM RAD ETISH:
'I'd love to, BUT I CAN'T.'

Bu — turg'un qolip. Odatda keyin sabab
aytiladi ('...I'm busy').

'How about + V-ING' — 'going' (V-ing!).
tasks.speak: 12  'How about going to the cinema?'  'I'd love to, but ..................... .'

tasks.whyUz:
'You'll' bosilgan → keyin ASOSIY shakl: HAVE.

⚠ 'HAVE fun' = zavqlanmoq (turg'un birikma).
'do fun' / 'make fun of' (masxara qilmoq —
boshqa ma'no).

tasks.prompt: 14  Where are ..................... your holidays this summer?
tasks.whyUz:
REJALASHTIRILGAN kelajak → Present Continuous.

'go FOR your holidays' = ta'tilga bormoq.

⚠ 'you going TO SPEND' ham to'g'ri
('Where are you going to spend your
holidays?').
tasks.speak: 14  Where are ..................... your holidays this summer?

tasks.prompt: 15  'What are you doing tonight?'  'We ..................... to the cinema.'
tasks.whyUz:
Savol Present Continuous da → javob ham.

'We ARE GOING to the cinema.' —
rejalashtirilgan kelajak.

7-band bilan bir xil qurilma.
tasks.speak: 15  'What are you doing tonight?'  'We ..................... to the cinema.'

tasks.promptUz: Juda ko'p shakar yeyish kerak emas.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ 'sugar' — SANALMAYDIGAN → 'TOO MUCH'.

  TOO MUCH + sanalmaydigan (sugar, money)
  TOO MANY + ko'plik (sweets, people)

8-band: 'too MANY sweets' — kitob ikkalasini
ataylab bir betga qo'ygan!

tasks.promptUz: Bu yerda baland ovozda musiqa qo'yish mumkin emas.
tasks.whyUz:
'PLAY music' = musiqa qo'ymoq/chalmoq.

'can't' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl: 'can't PLAY'.

Coursebook 101-bet: 'You can't PLAY LOUD
MUSIC.' (Missis Battersbi qoidalari)

⚠ 'LIGHT a fire' = olov YOQMOQ.

'BURN' = yonmoq; kuydirmoq (boshqa ma'no).

Coursebook 114-bet, 1-mashqning 9-bandi ham
shu: 'You mustn't LIGHT fires in the forest.'

light → lit → lit.

tasks.prompt: 19  You should always ......... your bed in the morning.
tasks.whyUz:
⚠ 'MAKE the bed' = ko'rpa-to'shakni
yig'ishtirmoq.

'DO the bed' — XATO!

exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
   1  C fizzy
   2  B full
   3  C a
   4  A blow
   5  B shall
   6  B clean
   7  A Can
   8  B Why
   9  C rainy
  10  B Let's


HAR BIRI NEGA:

 1  'Beer and Coke are FIZZY drinks.'
    ⚠ 'FIZZY drink' = gazlangan ichimlik.
    'regular drinks' — mantiqsiz.
    'hot drinks' — choy, qahva (pivo va
       kola SOVUQ ichiladi).

 2  'You shouldn't talk with your mouth
     FULL.'
    ⚠ 'with your mouth FULL' = og'iz to'la
    (turg'un ibora, Unit 14 dasturxon
    odobi).
    2-nazorat testining 3-mashqi, 4-bandi
    ham AYNAN shu edi!

 3  'I can't speak. I've got A sore throat.'
    ⚠ 'a sore throat' — BIRLIK sanaladigan
    → 'A'.
    'some sore throat' / 'the sore throat' —
       XATO.

 4  'You shouldn't BLOW your nose in
     public.'
    ⚠ 'BLOW your nose' = burnini qoqmoq.
    'hit your nose' — burnini urmoq
       (mantiqsiz).
    'clean your nose' — g'alati.

 5  'It's a lovely day. What SHALL we do?'
    ⚠ 'What shall we do?' = nima qilamiz?
    (taklif so'rash).
    'What must we do?' = nima qilishimiz
       shart? (majburiyat)
    'What will we do?' — bashorat, taklif
       emas.

 6  'Do I have to CLEAN my room?'
    ⚠ 'CLEAN a room' = xonani tozalamoq.
    'make my room' — XATO ('make the BED'
       ✓).
    'be my room' — mantiqsiz.

 7  'CAN we have two cheeseburgers, please?'
    ⚠ ILTIMOS/BUYURTMA → CAN.
    'Must we have ...?' = majburmizmi?
    'Should we have ...?' = maslahat
       so'rash.
    'please' iltimosni ko'rsatadi.

 8  'WHY don't you take the bus?'
    ⚠ 'Why don't you ...?' — MASLAhAT/TAKLIF
    shakli.
    'Where don't you ...' / 'What don't
       you ...' — mavjud emas.

 9  'It will be RAINY in Moscow tomorrow.'
    ⚠ 'IT will be' + SIFAT → RAINY.
    'rain' — OT ('There will be RAIN' ✓).
    'rained' — 2-shakl, kelajakda
       ishlatilmaydi.

    (1-mashqning 6 va 9-bandlari bilan bir
     xil qoida!)

10  'LET'S go to the disco!'
    ⚠ 'Let's + ASOSIY fe'l' — taklif.
    'What about GO' — XATO ('What about
       GOING' ✓, V-ing kerak).
    'Shall go' — XATO ('Shall WE go?' ✓,
       ega kerak).


⚠ 9-BAND — TESTNING ENG MUHIM QOIDASI:

  IT will be + SIFAT:
     rainy, sunny, foggy, snowy, windy,
     cloudy

  THERE will be + OT:
     rain, sun, fog, snow, wind, clouds

  Bu qoida testda UCh marta tekshirilgan
  (1-mashq 6, 9 va 2-mashq 9).


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  beer       = pivo
  fizzy      = gazlangan
  a sore throat = og'riyotgan tomoq
  to blow one's nose = burnini qoqmoq
  in public  = ommaviy joyda
  lovely     = ajoyib, yoqimli
  a cheeseburger = chizburger
  rainy      = yomg'irli
  a disco    = diskoteka

exercises.explanationUz:
BEShTA DIALOG — SAVOLNI TOPISh KERAK.

⚠ Har bandda savolning OXIRI allaqachon
bosilgan.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 1  A: 'WHAT'S THE matter, Steve?'
    B: 'I've got toothache.'

 2  A: 'CAN I BORROW your pen?'
    B: 'Of course you can.'

 3  A: 'DO I HAVE TO wash the dishes?'
    B: 'Yes, you do.'

 4  A: 'WHAT'S WRONG with you, Doug?'
    B: 'I feel very hot.'

 5  A: 'WHAT WILL THE WEATHER BE LIKE
        tomorrow?'
    B: 'It'll be windy tomorrow.'


QANDAY TOPILADI:

 1  Bosilgan: '... matter, Steve?'
    Javob: 'I've got TOOTHACHE.' — kasallik.
    → 'What's the matter?'

    ⚠ 'What's the matter?' = nima bo'ldi?
    (sog'liq yoki muammo haqida)

 2  Bosilgan: '... your pen?'
    Javob: 'Of course you CAN.'
    ⚠ 'you can' — demak savolda 'CAN I ...?'
    → 'Can I borrow your pen?'

 3  Bosilgan: '... wash the dishes?'
    Javob: 'Yes, you DO.'
    ⚠ 'you do' — demak savolda 'DO I ...?'
    → 'Do I have to wash the dishes?'

    (2-mashqning 6-bandi ham 'Do I have to
     ...?' edi.)

 4  Bosilgan: '... with you, Doug?'
    Javob: 'I FEEL VERY HOT.' — o'zini yomon
    his qilyapti.
    → 'What's wrong with you?'

    ⚠ 'What's wrong WITH you?' — predlog
    'with' SHART.

 5  Bosilgan: '... tomorrow?'
    Javob: 'IT'LL BE WINDY tomorrow.' —
    ob-havo bashorati.
    → 'What will the weather be like
       tomorrow?'


⚠ 2 va 3-BANDLAR — QISQA JAVOBDAN
SAVOLNI TOPISh:

  'Of course you CAN.'  → 'CAN I ...?'
  'Yes, you DO.'        → 'DO I ...?'

  Javobdagi yordamchi fe'l savolda ham
  bo'ladi.


⚠ 1 va 4-BANDLAR — IKKI XIL SAVOL:

  'What's the MATTER?'  — nima bo'ldi?
  'What's WRONG with you?' — nimangiz bor?

  Ikkalasi ham SOG'LIQ yoki MUAMMO haqida
  so'raydi, ma'nosi deyarli bir xil.

  ⚠ Farqi: 'wrong' bilan 'WITH' predlogi
  SHART:
     'What's wrong WITH you?'  ✓
     'What's the matter WITH you?' ✓ ham
        mumkin
     'What's wrong you?'  ✗


⚠ 5-BAND — 'LIKE' SHART:

  'What will the weather be LIKE tomorrow?'

  4-nazorat testi (hozirgi zamon):
     'What's the weather LIKE today?'
  5-nazorat testi (o'tmish):
     'What WAS the weather LIKE in Madrid?'

  Uchchala zamonda ham 'LIKE' bor!


DIQQAT — 'TOOTHACHE':
  'I've got TOOTHACHE.' — artiklsiz
  (Britaniya).
  'I've got A toothache.' — Amerika.

  Boshqa og'riqlar: headache, stomachache,
  backache, earache.


DIQQAT — 'BORROW' va 'LEND':
  BORROW = qarz OLMOQ
     'Can I BORROW your pen?'
  LEND = qarz BERMOQ
     'Can you LEND me your pen?'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  What's the matter? = Nima bo'ldi?
  toothache  = tish og'rig'i
  to borrow  = qarz olmoq
  to wash the dishes = idish yuvmoq
  What's wrong with ...? = ... ga nima bo'ldi?
  windy      = shamolli

sentencePatterns.formula: IT WILL BE + [SIFAT].   /   THERE WILL BE + [OT].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It will be windy in Miami. There will be snow in Toronto. There will be rain tomorrow.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Mayamida shamolli bo'ladi. Torontoda qor bo'ladi. Ertaga yomg'ir bo'ladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Testning ENG MUHIM qoidasi — 3 marta
tekshirilgan.

sentencePatterns.formula: [hozirgi holat]. I WILL + [ASOSIY fe'l].   ↔   I AM GOING TO + [ASOSIY fe'l] + [kelajak vaqt].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: I'm hungry. I will make a sandwich.  /  I'm going to buy a house next year.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Qornim och. Sendvich tayyorlayman. / Kelasi yil uy sotib olmoqchiman.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ WILL — shu zahotgi qaror;
BE GOING TO — oldindan o'ylangan niyat.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You mustn't smoke in hospitals. You shouldn't speak loudly in a library.
He's going to save money to buy a new bicycle.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U yangi velosiped sotib olish uchun pul yig'moqchi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'TO + fe'l' — MAQSAD ('... uchun').
'because' bo'lsa ega va fe'l kerak bo'lardi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Why don't you stop eating sweets?

sentencePatterns.formula: IT WILL BE + [SIFAT].   /   THERE WILL BE + [OT].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: It will be sunny in Milan. There will be fog in Paris.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Milanda quyoshli bo'ladi. Parijda tuman bo'ladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Testning ENG MUHIM qoidasi — 3 marta
tekshirilgan.
SIFAT → IT;  OT → THERE.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: There is a hole in the road. He is going to fall.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Yo'lda chuqur bor. U yiqilib tushadi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
DALIL bor → BE GOING TO.
Dalilsiz bashorat → WILL.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: You mustn't smoke in here. You shouldn't eat too much sugar.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Bu yerda chekmang. Juda ko'p shakar yemang.

Kitob ikkalasini bir betga qo'ygan
(8 va 16-bandlar).

sentencePatterns.formula: Would you like TO + [fe'l]?  —  I'd love to. / I'd love to, but I can't.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Would you like to come windsurfing with me? — I'd love to.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Men bilan vindserfingga borasizmi? — Juda xohlardim.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
Taklifni MULOYIM rad etish:
'I'd love to, BUT I can't.'

sentencePatterns.formula: What WILL the weather BE LIKE tomorrow?  —  It'll be windy.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What will the weather be like tomorrow? — It'll be windy tomorrow.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ertaga ob-havo qanday bo'ladi? — Shamolli bo'ladi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'LIKE' uchchala zamonda ham SHART:
is / was / will be + LIKE.
